title: Sheaf coinduction with multiplication action and evaluation counit
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Put $A=f_*\mathcal O_Y$, $T:\operatorname{Mod}(A)\to\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$ equal to restriction of scalars along $f^\sharp$, and $M=T(A)$. There is a functor $H:\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)\to\operatorname{Mod}(A)$ with a natural isomorphism $i:H T\cong\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(M,-)$ [def-pur-sheaf-hom] and an adjunction $T\dashv H$. For every $\mathcal F$, open $U$, $a\in A(U)$, $\phi\in H(\mathcal F)(U)$ and $W\subset U$, $b\in A(W)$, the identification satisfies $i(a\phi)_W(b)=i(\phi)_W(a|_W b)$. The counit on sections is $\phi\mapsto i(\phi)_U(1)$.

proof.text: Apply the functor-and-action construction to obtain H, its natural isomorphism i to internal Hom after restriction, and the action formula. No adjunction is assumed by this lemma.

Apply the evaluation Hom-bijection lemma to H and i with their action formula, obtaining CoreHomEquiv e and its inverse evaluation formula. Construct the adjunction with Adjunction.mkOfHomEquiv e. Its counit at F is e inverse applied to the identity of H(F). Specialize the inverse formula to that identity, simplify the identity component, and retain the action formula from the first step.
